blocks.text: Jab ionic compounds pani mein ghulte hain to woh ions mein toot jate hain, aur phir pani ke molecules in ions ko gher lete hain.

blocks.title: Hydration
blocks.text: Woh process jis mein pani ke molecules solute ke ions ko gher lete hain aur un se interact karte hain, hydration kehlata hai.
Pani ke molecules aur ions ke darmiyan jo forces banti hain unhen ion-dipole forces kehte hain (Figure 6.5). Is wajah se aqueous solution ke tamam ions hydrated kehlate hain.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf peele cations (+) aur hare anions (-) ki ionic lattice. Oopar pani ka ek molecule (surkh O aur do safaid H) apne O sire se ek cation ki taraf khincha hai, O par delta- aur H par delta+; neeche pani ka molecule apne H siron se ek anion ki taraf khincha hai, H par delta+ aur O par delta-. Khamdar teer lattice se ek hydrated cation tak jate hain jise chhe pani ke molecules O sire andar kiye ghere hain, aur ek hydrated anion tak jise chhe molecules H sire andar kiye ghere hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.5: Hydration ke amal se ionic compound ka ghulna (kitab ki Figure 6.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pani ke molecule ka oxygen wala sira thoda manfi (δ⁻) aur hydrogen wale sire thode musbat (δ⁺) hain. Musbat ion (Na⁺) ki taraf oxygen ka rukh hota hai, aur manfi ion (Cl⁻) ki taraf hydrogen ka. Har ion ke gird pani ka ek ghera ban jata hai.
Ion-dipole force ki wajah se kashish ki energy ko enthalpy of hydration kehte hain. Kitab is ki tareef yun karti hai:

blocks.title: Enthalpy of hydration
blocks.text: Woh enthalpy change jo tab hoti hai jab solute ka ek mole zyada pani mein ghul kar standard conditions par infinitely dilute solution banaye.
Is ki alamat ΔHhyd hai. Yeh energy hamesha bahar nikalti hai, kyun ke is mein ion-dipole bond banta hai.
Hydration energy ki miqdar par asar dalne wale factors
Heat of hydration in factors par depend karti hai:

In dono ko mila kar ek lafz istemal karte hain: “charge density”, yani fi unit area charge. Chhote ion par zyada charge ho to charge density zyada hoti hai, aur ulta bhi. Zyada charge density wale ions ko pani ke molecules zor se khainchte hain, is liye hydration energy zyada hoti hai. Misal ke taur par in ions ki enthalpies of hydration ki tarteeb yeh hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehli line: Na⁺, Mg²⁺, Al³⁺ mein charge 1, 2, 3 barhta hai aur size chhota hota hai, is liye hydration energy barhti hai. Doosri line: Mg²⁺, Ca²⁺, Sr²⁺ ka charge ek jaisa (2+) hai magar group mein neeche size barhta hai, is liye hydration energy kam hoti hai.
Isi bunyaad par anions (manfi ions) ki hydration energy bhi samjhai ja sakti hai.

blocks.prompt: Do ions ka charge ek jaisa hai magar ek chhota hai; do aur ions ka size ek jaisa hai magar ek par zyada charge hai. Har jore mein kis ki enthalpy of hydration zyada exothermic hogi?
blocks.explanation: Chhote ion ki, aur zyada charge wale ion ki. Dono ki charge density zyada hai, is liye woh pani ke dipoles ko zyada zor se khainchte hain aur zyada energy nikalti hai.

items: Hydration: pani ke molecules ion-dipole forces se ions ko gherte hain; ΔHhyd hamesha kharij hoti hai.
Charge density (zyada charge, chhota size) barhe to hydration energy barhti hai: Na⁺ < Mg²⁺ < Al³⁺; Mg²⁺ > Ca²⁺ > Sr²⁺.
